mechanics.claim: The empowered proc replaces Poppy's next basic attack, adding bonus range and bonus magic damage to that attack.
mechanics.quote: Periodically, '''Poppy's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-attack}} is empowered to throw her buckler, gaining {{sti|350 '''bonus''' range}} and dealing {{pp|20 + (180-20)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.

mechanics.claim: If the empowered attack kills the target (or the target is already dead), the buckler returns immediately to Poppy instead of landing on the ground.
mechanics.quote: If the buckler kills the target, or if the target is already dead when the buckler hits it, the buckler will bounce back to '''Poppy''' instead of falling.

mechanics.claim: The shield is only granted when Poppy physically moves over the fallen buckler to retrieve it, not automatically on proc.
mechanics.quote: '''Poppy''' can move over the buckler to retrieve it, gaining a {{tip|shield}} for {{sti|health|{{as|{{pp|key=%|11 + (20-11)/17*(x-1) for 20}} of her '''maximum''' health}}}} for 3 seconds.

mechanics.claim: Poppy will not throw the buckler if her attack windup begins before the passive's cooldown has finished, delaying the proc to a later attack.
mechanics.quote: '''Poppy''' will not throw the buckler if she begins her {{tip|attack windup}} before ''Iron Ambassador's'' cooldown has elapsed.

mechanics.claim: The buckler-throw attack is treated as a melee attack regardless of Poppy's actual attack type, which can matter for on-hit effects.
